[R2] Claude Desktop / filesystem can access /home/dev
The server is rooted at the home directory or /, so a prompt injection can read SSH keys, cloud credentials and browser data; scope it to the project directory.
[R5] Claude Desktop / filesystem can read /home/dev/.aws/credentials
The credential file is inside /home/dev, which the server can access; one prompt injection is enough to exfiltrate it. Narrow the root.
[R5] Claude Desktop / filesystem can read /home/dev/.ssh/id_ed25519
The credential file is inside /home/dev, which the server can access; one prompt injection is enough to exfiltrate it. Narrow the root.
[R3] Claude Desktop / filesystem runs unpinned package @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem via npx
Without a version, every start fetches the latest release, so a compromised or typosquatted publish runs immediately; pin an exact version.
[R3] Claude Desktop / github runs unpinned package @modelcontextprotocol/server-github via npx

[R3] Cursor / git runs unpinned package mcp-server-git via uvx

[R4] Claude Code / slack is not routed through the mcpgraph proxy
Its tool calls reach the server without a policy check or audit record; run `mcpgraph install` to wrap it.

[R7] Cursor / remote-insecure uses plain http:// to 10.0.0.5:8080
Tool calls, results and any auth headers cross the network unencrypted and can be read or modified in transit; use https://.
